title: Warm Garlicky Italian Vegan Cheese Panettone
description: A warm and energizing Italian dish featuring a garlicky and cheesy panettone, made with soda water and glazed to perfection, all in a vegan-friendly agave-leaf vessel.

ingredients.name: glaze made from maple syrup and lemon juice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine flour, yeast, salt, garlic powder, and dried oregano in a large mixing bowl.
Add soda water, olive oil, and agave syrup to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a panettone form.
Place the panettone in an agave-leaf vessel and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the panettone from the oven and brush it with the glaze made from maple syrup and lemon juice.
Sprinkle vegan mozzarella shreds on top of the panettone and return it to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the panettone from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
